thesis: The site is a sun-hours check first and a nursery second: every section answers how many hours of sun the spot gets and what fits, so the drive is earned before it is made.

signature.name: sun-dial
signature.summary: A drawn SVG sun-path arc over a house roofline that sets the hero input, repeats as mini dials on service cards, drives price-table pot-size rings, shows open hours as a lit arc, and resets in the footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='sun-dial'.

motion.intro: Sun marker traces arc from dawn to default 6-hour position while shortlist count fades in; ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Pinned desktop dial rotation with three plant-group cards wiping in; mobile stacked with clip reveal.
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left via scaleX on cards and buttons.
